{{Event Infobox
| Name  = Purifier
| Image = Event-Purifier.png
}}
{{E|Purifier}} is a shrine [[Event]] found in all [[Acts]].

Shrine events occur less frequently than other events.

== Options ==
{{Frame|Pray}} {{TS|positive||Remove a card from your deck.}}

{{Frame|Leave}} Nothing happens.

== Dialogue ==
<blockquote>
<i> Before you lies an elaborate shrine to a forgotten spirit. </i>

{{Frame|Pray}}
<blockquote>
<i> As you kneel in reverence, you feel a weight lifted off your shoulders.</i>
</blockquote>

{{Frame|Leave}}
<blockquote>
<i> You ignore the shrine. </i>
</blockquote>
</blockquote>

== Notes ==
* This probably would not work as an air purifier.
